document.abstract: Two recent events, the advent of high definition television and of film crews joining the digital world, have demonstrated the need for engineers, technicians and DPs to have a better knowledge and understanding of each others' requirements and operating procedures. This paper attempts to provide practical image control solutions and to identify often overlooked issues.

authors.bio: David F.E. Corley - President and CEO - DSC Laboratories — DSC Laboratories was formed in 1962 by David and Susan Corley to provide precision products and services to the television and AV communities. — David's research in image improvement has resulted in many patents and technological advances including: seamless panoramas, dichroic additive printer, vibration-less electronic shutter, ambient light illuminator, Optical Signal Generators and High Dynamic range test charts. — Active in SMPTE and IEEE engineering committees, David has received numerous awards including the Fuji Gold Medal. He is a past Canadian Governor and Director of Education of SMPTE, also a Life Fellow.
authors.name: David F.E. Corley

authors.bio: Shirley Li BSc. Beijing - Research Manager — Born in ShangHai, Shirley was educated at the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) in Beijing. As a visiting scholar Shirley worked with the Physics Department at Simon Fraser University as research scientist. — Since joining DSC Laboratories in 1994, Shirley has headed research in colorimetry and the development of new test materials and systems.
